description: Two brothers, Ram and Ratan, find themselves at odds with each other as the former supports the mill owner, Sewakram, while the latter forms a union to protest against him.

Title: 359. Battle Flame
description: The trials and tribulations of a platoon of U.S. Marines, led by 1st Lt. Frank Davis, during the Korean War.

Title: 360. Love Marriage
description: Sunil Kumar rents a room in the city where he is to play cricket for the home team. He meets with the landlord's daughter, who instantly dislikes him. But after watching him play cricket, she falls in love with him, and both decide to get married. After the marriage both decide to re-locate and do so, living harmoniously for sometime, before differences arise, threatening to break up their "love marriage".

Title: 362. Escucha mi canción
description: Joselito plays an orphan a shrew treats badly.But he takes a job in a gypsies ' small circus as a singer of course .

Title: 363. A Stranger in My Arms
description: After the Korean War, an Air Force pilot meets the family of his KIA navigator and recalls, in flashbacks, the circumstances of their ordeal after being shot down.

Title: 364. Anyakôro
description: Adapted from Naoya Shiga's novel about the emotional turmoil of a man who suspects that his wife is committing adultery with his father.

Title: 365. Paprika
description: Pop star Willy and his manager-wife Anita are happy but have problems with the help in their chaotic household. Anita's rich friend Ilona needs a hideout and poses as their maid only to fall for Anita's nerdy brother, a frog specialist.

Title: 366. Plan 9 from Outer Space in Color
description: Aliens from outer space reanimate the Earth's dead in an attempt to save the human race. Restored and In Color.

Title: 367. Head of a Tyrant
description: A beautiful girl plans to seduce, then murder, the brutal conqueror who has taken over her city.

Title: 368. The Living Coffin
description: A cowboy and his sidekick meet a ranching family that is haunted by spirits and vampires.

Title: 369. A Stranger Knocks
description: A stranger knocks on the the door of a widow who's husband was tortured and killed by the Danish Nazis during World War Two. They fall in love, but then, suddenly, she realizes that her lover is the man who murdered her husband.

Title: 370. The Navy Lark
description: Film version of a popular BBC radio show about the incompetent crew of a Royal Navy ship.

Title: 371. The Saga of the Vagabonds
description: Lord Taro must deliver a money chest but is robbed by brigands led by Jibu. One of Jibu's men, Rokuro, steals the money from Jibu, but after meeting and befriending Taro, Rokuro decides to return the money to Taro. But Taro's unscrupulous brother Jiro falsely accuse Taro of the theft, and Taro reactively joins the outlaw band and encourages them to steal from the nobles and give to the poor.

Title: 372. An Angel on Wheels
description: A female guardian angel tries to convince Pierre not to marry his rich but mean fiance, but rather fall in love with a stewardess who is secretly in love with him.

Title: 373. Son of the Red Corsair
description: Enrico di Ventimiglia, the Son of the Red Corsair, travels through the Spanish conquests of Central America in search of the stepsister he has never met.

Title: 374. Die Halbzarte
description: Nicole is a young librarian who writes romantic poetry. A successful new erotic novel, gives her the idea to secretly write a daring play, only about sex.

Title: 375. Life in Danger
description: The inhabitants of a small village, led by a war veteran, try to catch a vagrant, who they suspect to be an escaped mental patient.

Title: 376. The Diary of a High School Bride
description: A 17-year-old high school senior must justify her wedding to a 24-year-old law student to both her parents and her unbalanced ex-boyfriend.

Title: 377. Serious Charge
description: A vicar falsely accused of assaulting a youth attempts to prove his innocence and save his reputation.

Title: 378. Five Gates to Hell
description: A small group of Red Cross doctors and nurses are held captive by Chinese guerrillas in Vietnam.

Title: 379. Verboten!
description: A young American serviceman stationed in Germany after the fall of the Third Reich jeopardizes his position with the Marshall Plan relief effort by breaking the non-fraternization rule and falling in love with a young German woman. He uses his position to obtain food and luxuries for her that are in short supply, and all seems to be going well for the couple. What he doesn't realize is that the Werewolves, the Nazi guerrilla movement, has plans in which he features heavily.

A managing editor of a LA newspaper must put together headlines for the next day in a way that'll attract the potential readers, deal with hectic going-ons at the workplace and have a serious talk with his wife about her wish to adopt.

Title: 381. Yoru no kawa
description: An artistically and commercially successful kimono designer begins an affair with a married man. But when his wife dies, her reaction is not as expected.

Title: 382. Zorro, the Avenger
description: Masked crusader Zorro and his father, Don Alejandro, face off against mysterious despot The Eagle in a fight for control of old Spanish California. Compiled from six episodes of the original Disney Zorro series.

Title: 384. Lost Souls
description: A gang of violent criminals holds captive a group of young women and men in an abandoned mining complex.

Title: 385. Life Does Not Forgive
description: The young intellectual hero, mortally wounded on the front lines of the Second World War, recalls his own past and that of his father, attempting to answer fundamental questions regarding the rationale of war and preparations for war

Title: 386. Ferry to Hong Kong
description: Mark Conrad, a habitual drunk and troublemaker with a shady past, is expelled by Hong Kong police after one too many bar fights. He's sent to Macao on the Fa Tsan, a ferry owned by Captain Hart. Conrad's papers are out of order and Macao refuses him entry. Unable to go ashore, Conrad is a permanent passenger on the ferry with Hart, who detests him. It's all one long, lazy voyage for Conrad until one fateful trip when an encounter with a typhoon and pirates forces Conrad to choose between an aimless drifter's life and becoming a man again.

Title: 388. The Redeemer
description: The Passion of Jesus starting with His arrest and trial that was shot near Madrid and features narration by Sebastion Cabot. Jesus' face is never seen but in the English version he is voiced by veteran Hollywood actor Macdonald Carey.

Title: 389. The Headless Ghost
description: Three teenagers encounter a ghost who is in limbo until he retrieves his lost head. They do their bit to help him find it.

Title: 390. Marie of the Isles
description: In 1635, Jacques du Parquet, the nephew of the well known explorer Belain d'Esnambic, enters a tavern in Dieppe, and falls in love with the daughter of the bartender, Marie Bonnard. He knows his noble family would disaprove such a marriage; besides, he is nominated for the post of governor in Martinica. He promised never to forget Marie, but as time goes by, she will accept to marry a rich and unscrupulous man, Monsieur de Saint-André. When her husband is appointed to serve in Martinica as General Commissioner, Marie demands to go with him. At her arrival, all sorts of trouble arrive: pirates take action against travellers and goods, rotten deals set the two officers against each other, and finally jealousy settles to make things worse.

Title: 391. Rider in Blue
description: When private eye John Hillman is on assignment in London his wife Kajsa visits the Army's riding school at Strömsholm, Sweden. She gets involved in the strange murder of the Blue Rider. Unknown to everyone at Strömsholm.

Title: 392. Whirlpool
description: On the run from her murderous wartime partner in crime Herman, Lora hides on a Rhine barge captained by Rolf. The crew of three - Georg, Dina and Braun - quickly accepts her. But, both Herman and the police are on her trail.

Title: 393. We Are the Lambeth Boys
description: Seminal piece of documentary film by New Wave director Karel Reisz follows the daily activites of members of the Lambeth Youth club in late 1950's London.

Title: 394. Bouboulina
description: Captain Lascarina decides to organize the revolution in Spetses despite her double widowhood. In the struggle for the liberation of Greece, she gives all her property, fighting along with her lads.

Title: 395. Plunderers of Painted Flats
description: To scare the squatters from the cattle country he claims as his own, Ed Sampson orders the Martin farm house burned.

Title: 396. Night of the Quarter Moon
description: A young man returns to San Francisco and his wealthy family with a new bride. His family objects to his marriage as his wife is mixed race and his mother is determined to have it annulled.

Title: 397. ¿Dónde vas, Alfonso XII?
description: The youth of Prince Alfonso who would become King Alfonso XII of Spain after Queen Isabel II abdication, centered in his love for his cousin María de las Mercedes. Daughter of one of his mother's political opponents, their marriage against the Queen's will won for them popular approval and helped achieving political stability in a turmoiled country. Her early and tragic death would inspire the song of the film's title. The film was so successful that a second part ("¿Dónde vas triste de ti?") would follow.

Title: 398. Yo pecador
description: The life of Father Fray José Francisco de Guadalupe Mojica who was a famous Mexican singer and actor (José Mojica) before retiring to religious life.

Title: 399. Veerapandiya Kattabomman
description: When the British East India Company forces polygar Kattabomman to pay taxes, levies and be their subsidiary ruler, he openly defies their policy and battles them until his arrest and hanging.

Title: 400. Hot Money Girl
description: Hidden somewhere inside St. Teresa's Convent in Czechoslovakia is a box containing a fortune in jewels. A lot of people are after it.

Title: 401. Oh! Qué mambo
description: Miguel Montero foils a bank robbery and finds success as a night club singer, but doesn't know his wife is being courted by an Italian fitness instructor.

Title: 402. María de la O
description: María de la O leaves her family and her former boyfriend Miguel to go with a rich landowner who's supposedly in love with her...

Title: 404. Samurai Saga
description: Japanese version of 'Cyrano de Bergerac', a poet/swordsman with a huge nose who loves a woman who loves another. Ignoring his true feelings, he helps them get together.

Title: 405. Riff Raff Girls
description: Vicky de Berlin, a female gangster haunted by wartime memories, runs a floating night club in Brussels. Marcel, her partner and lover, is in charge of printing forged banknotes in the bottom of a boat. He decides to rob the Bank of Belgium and exchange a huge sum of counterfeit money for its genuine equivalent. But things get complicated after Yoko, the leader of another gang and her lover The Bug interfere.

Title: 407. The Big Operator
description: During the 1950s, a corrupt labor union boss and the mob silence all those who witness their shady activities, but an honest union member threatens to testify in front of a Senate Committee, thus becoming a murder target.

Title: 408. Lazarillo
description: The story of Lazarillo, a poor boy who must live by his wits after being sold to a series of cruel masters.

Title: 409. Make Mine a Double
description: A WWII British secret agent has a desperate mission in occupied France. An airman who is his double is enlisted in the scheme with the intention of deceiving the enemy, but everyone gets confused.

Title: 410. Lotna
description: Poland, during the World War. Lotna is a magnificent specimen of Arabian horse, the pride of her owner, too old to actually ride her but to whom she remains faithful nevertheless. The Polish cavalry army is also proud of their land, and loyal to rules, and custom. The German army is leading an overwhelming speed attack with tanks, an almost unheard of weapon, and bringing a way of life to an end. It's the last battle between Lotna (speed horse) and Blitzkriega (speed war).

Title: 411. Una señora movida
description: A woman deceives her family by making them think she murdered her butler.

Title: 412. Murder in Kolonaki
description: A shroud of mystery covers the brutal murder of a successful artist. As the main suspect's sceptical son begins a personal investigation to prove his father's innocence, will he succeed where the Athens police have failed?

Title: 413. The Overcoat
description: A story about a government clerk who has his precious new overcoat stolen. No-one seems willing to help him retrieve his prized possession, a fact that continues to concern him even when he is beyond the grave.

Title: 414. Rue de Paris
description: While Henri was a POW during the war, his wife passed away and he returned to face the challenges of bringing up three children alone. Henri may get drunk and angry at times but he also has a better side that will not stay buried.

Title: 415. Duel with Death
description: For centuries, the Norwegian Björndal family has been gaining wealth and prestige, painstakingly conquering farm land on nature to make their estate Björndal the envy of all the region, while their proud rivals, the noble von Gall family on the castle Borkland, lost fortune. The Björndal patriarch Dag Sr., scarred in the face during a bear kill, has two sons: his fierce first-born favorite Tore shares his love for taunting the von Galls, while the gentle Dag Jr. rather enjoys the silence of the forest. When Tore seems to court the equally proud and stubborn Elisabeth von Gall, she makes her military suitor Lt. Margas challenge him to a duel- Tore, armed only with his coach whip, is pierced by his saber and his corps carried away by the river; now Elisabeth turns away from him. Even a month later Dag Sr. refuses to believe the missing Tore must be dead. Hunting the last bear, Dag Jr. loses his rifle and is badly wounded killing the beast with his knife; Adelheid and her father, retired royal guards Major Barre, friends of the von Galls, witness this, bring him home and are invited to stay at Björndal, where Adelheid nurses him and slips out Tore's fate to Dag Sr.; she and Dag Jr. fall in love. Even when her father confesses the mortgaged castle estate is near financial ruin, Elisabeth refuses to consider finding a rich husband as Margas, who just died, could have been. At Christmas, Dag Sr. invites Adhelheid to stay indefinitely, and she persuades him to attend church for the first time since the death of his wife Thérèse, 20 years earlier- there he springs the lovers to marry. In Spring Dag Sr. has a major wood contract for the English mines, which can only be fulfilled with the castle's cooperation; the von Galls finally learn the Björndals have bought all their debts. Elisabeth refuses the logs customary passage by the river trough the castle estate so father Björndal chooses, at great expense and inhuman effort, to create an alternative route, even if it kills a workman to Dag Jr. disgust which even makes him leave to become a sailor, and forecloses on the castle- the proud Elisabeth rather sets fire to it and burns in it. Only the next Christmas Dag Sr. learns from von Gall that Elisabeth secretly loved Tore; trying to reach his meanwhile returned son and Adelheid, the old man catches a fatal cold in the snow, and dies after learning he has a newborn grandson, Tore.

Title: 416. Il nemico di mia moglie
description: Luciana and Marco are a couple in crisis because she, a lover of the US style and employed in a record store, can not stand that he, instead of dedicating himself to the work from which he is continually fired, has the fixed goal of football Sundays.

Title: 417. Freddy unter fremden Sternen
description: Freddy has inherited a land and house in Canada from his uncle. An orphan boy, Stefan, had smuggled himself as a blind passenger on board.

Title: 418. Personal Assistant
description: Ramapoda Dutta gets a job in an all-female company as the personal assistant to the Managing Director.

Title: 419. Vazha Vaitha Daivam
description: Watch the full movie, Vazha Vaitha Deivam, only on Eros Now. Vazha Vaitha Deivam is a 1959 Indian Tamil film, directed by M.A. Thirumugham and produced by Sakthidas. The film stars Saroja Devi,Gemini Ganesan and Kannamba in lead roles. The film had musical score by K.V Mahadevan.

Title: 420. The Bandit of Zhobe
description: In 19th century India, the rebellious Kasim Khan fights the English.

Title: 421. The Great Van Robbery
description: Interpol detective Caesar Smith tracks robbers of the Royal Mint van. He travels to Rio de Janeiro, Rome and Paris and establishes the guilt of a London coffee importer.

Title: 422. Ferdinando I° re di Napoli
description: In 1806 Naples, King Ferdinand I of the Two Sicilies is frowned upon by the people, especially the comic theatrical Pulcinella, who continually delivers hard sermons, earning a reputation among the Neapolitans.

Title: 423. Follow a Star
description: Norman Truscott is a store worker who dreams of stardom. Vernon Carew is a singer whose star is fading. Vernon manages to get a recording of Norman singing and passes it off as himself.

Title: 424. Maiden's Cheek
description: A young idealist scholar at an all-girls boarding school comes face to face with the institution's privileged students. Will they learn a thing or two about respect? Can a little discipline pave the way for a fresh whirlwind romance?

Title: 425. Road Back
description: Dan, Freddy and Carda are roaming about Prague thinking of how to get some money. They decide to break into the box-office of a cinema, but a passer-by interferes. Freddy loses his jacket in the fight, but all three young men escape at the end. Freddy is afraid to return home and is hiding at the docks. The police identify him from his papers, which they found in the jacket. At the docks Freddy meets the customs officer Tonka and stirs her to pity with a made-up story about a bullying father.

Title: 426. Three Stooges Fun-O-Rama
description: Columbia Pictures feature program of 4 unedited Three Stooges shorts, that feature Joe Besser, and were originally released between 1957-1959.

Title: 427. Pêcheur d'Islande
description: The new captain of a cursed fishing vessel falls in love with the owner's daughter, which displeases his jealous lover.

Title: 428. The Green Mare
description: A feud between families in 1870's rural France.

Title: 429. The Chasers
description: Two young men, one shy and one self-confident, spend a fast-paced night in Paris trying to pick up chicks. They confront every possible difficulty.

Title: 430. Roadracers
description: The father of a race car driver blames him for a death on the track, disowns him, and sponsors a rival racer.

Title: 431. Ce corps tant désiré
description: A man falls in love with Lina, a hot girl with a racy past who creates a sensation among the workers.

Title: 432. Sir Taqiyyat el-Ikhfa
description: Faseeh while playing in his father's lab, he causes the emergence of a goblin, which gets burnt, leaving a magical powder that makes things invisible. His elder brother Asfour discovers an invisible hat in the lab, but then troubles begin.

Title: 433. Stournara 288
description: The residents of the block of flats in 288, Stournara street have their own history. The doorkeeper watches carefully every little thing that happens in the apartment building and knows every resident's secrets.

Title: 435. The Princess with the Golden Star
description: A Czech fairy tale about a princess named Lada who runs away from home in a mouse-fur disguise in order to escape an unwanted, forced marriage.

Title: 436. Cry Tough
description: Puerto Rican ex-con tries to go straight, but is tempted back to his old life by his former gang.

Title: 437. Hound-Dog Man
description: A farm boy (Dennis Holmes) and his dog go hunting with his teenage brother (Fabian) and an older friend (Stuart Whitman) in 1912.

Title: 438. Julie the Redhead
description: The artist Edouard Lavigne falls in love with a young girl but must quickly leave her because her parents are opposed to this relationship. Edourd's son will go in search of this woman and will thereby meet her daughter. About a love story that continues from one generation to the next.

Title: 441. Watusi
description: Alan Quatermain's son comes to Africa to find the treasure his father was unable to bring home.

Title: 442. The Policeman of the 16th Precinct
description: Three poor friends, Ilias, Thomás and Vangelis, decide to commit a burglary, but everything, although being planned with detail, goes wrong.

Title: 443. Kiku to Isamu
description: Immediately after the Second World War, sister Kiku and brother Isamu, whose mother was a prostitute and the father was a GI, live with their grandmother in the country. Because their colour, hair is different from Japanese, they'd have a hard time, being bullied or treated like unusual creatures. Unfortunately, racism and some other issues such as being different still exist in Japan but the way Kiku portrayed was quite refreshing as she's so strong and fighting against all those stupidity and cliché.

Title: 444. The Heart of a Man
description: Frankie, an out-of-work sailor, meets Bud, a tramp who claims he is a millionaire. Bud gives him a shilling and promises him that if he can make £100 from it, he will be given £1,000. Armed with this, Frankie goes off to pursue his singing career and win the heart of Julie, the girlfriend of upper-class criminal Tony.

Title: 445. The Little Savage
description: After burying stolen treasure on a desert island, a pirate shoots his partner and leaves him for dead. After recovering, the man finds a 10-year-old boy on the island. Years later, the pirates meet again and shoot it out.

Title: 446. Hubb lel-abad
description: Amal is married to a criminal, upon his return from jail, her lover Ashraf kills him unintentionally. Ashraf asks his brother Mahmoud for help. An innocent man may get executed so Amal has to choose between her love and her conscience.

Title: 447. The Purple Gang
description: The story of the infamous Purple Gang, a ring of bootleggers, hijackers and killers in 1920s' Detroit.

Title: 448. King of the Wild Stallions
description: A young widow and her son on an isolated ranch find themselves being protected by a wild stallion.

Title: 449. Didi
description: Gopal's sister believes that she knows what is best for him. But a series of events causes turbulence in the family.

Title: 450. The Buddenbrooks
description: First part of two of the saga of the troubled Buddenbrook family and their business in mid-19th-century Germany.

Title: 451. Fridolfs farliga ålder
description: Selma and her friend Agatha are watching a movie on TV. Agatha starts to talk about older men and their dangerous age, but Selma can't image that her husband Fridolf is among those.

Title: 452. Prisoner of the Volga
description: A vicious play of intrigue, about love, desire and betrayal, in the dress of the military at the Cossacks around 1890.

Title: 453. A Woman's Temptation
description: A young widow, struggling to make ends meet, finds stolen money but the thieves want it back.

Title: 454. Beyond All Limits
description: In a Mexican fishing village, gringo Jim Gatsby hatches an illegal shrimp-catching scheme and runs afoul of local authorities as well as of jealous Mexican fisherman Pepe Gamboa who suspects his wife Magdalena of infidelity.

Title: 455. Zamach
description: Set in the occupied Warsaw, the film tells the story of the mission carried out by the student underground resistance group to execute the hated SS General Franz Kutchera.

Title: 456. Air Hostess
description: Set in the 1950s, the emerging period of new occupations --air hostess. Three beautiful young girls pass the interview of air hostess and start their new life and career. There are so many stories between the three new air hostesses and two airplane captains.

Title: 457. Ragazzi del Juke-Box
description: When a promising record company president is arrested, his daughter takes over his company to promote her own rock and roll music by promoting various young singers.

Title: 458. The Nights of Lucretia Borgia
description: Central Italy in the Late Middle Ages. Federico, a virtuous nobleman from an impoverished family, is brought into service by autocrat Cesare Borgia. His promiscuous sister Lucrezia seems to have an amorous interest in Federico and wants him as her lover though Federico is in love with Diana, the Duke of Alva's daughter, whom he has saved from being raped. When he learns about Diana's feud against the Borgia clan, he becomes aware of their infamous deeds.

Title: 459. Kalabog en Bosyo
description: Together again for laughs, the nation's top comedy duo at their craziest, funniest best.

Title: 460. Vivir del cuento
description: Renato, in love with Elsa, feigns mourning for his late wife to his former father-in-law to obtain a loan. He hires Chóforo to prevent Elsa from marrying, not knowing that Chóforo wants her too.

Title: 461. Five Bold Women
description: A Texas Marshal transports five female prisoners to prison but their stagecoach is attacked en route by the Comanches and the ex-husband of one prisoner attempts to free her.

Title: 462. Vallatud kurvid
description: At a race in progress, Vaike meets bikers Raivo, a ladies' man, and Heino. Her twin Maret helps her navigate the ensuing adventures.

Title: 463. The Restless and the Damned
description: Set in French Polynesia, a man trades his old life for one in the Pacific.

Title: 464. Violent Women
description: Five female prisoners murder an informer, then escape through a drainpipe into the streets of New York.

Title: 465. Boy of Two Worlds
description: Young boy whose father was from Denmark and mother from a tropical island must live with his paternal aunt in Denmark. His skin color becomes an issue right away and he decides to escape and live in the forest.

Title: 466. Nujum Pak Belalang
description: Based on a Malay folklore, this movie tells the story of Pak Belalang and his son who conspire to portray the latter as an astrologer in an attempt to help out fellow villagers in trouble. Convinced by his actions, the Penghulu (Mayor) brings him to the royal palace to help solve a robbery but the situation turns complicated when their lies began unravelling.

Title: 467. First Love
description: Various sentimental events of a group of young people in Rome.

Title: 470. My Pal the Gypsy
description: What do the well-to-do Védrineses have to do with a bunch of unpolished Gypsies like the Pittuitis? Nothing surely ... except that Théo Védrines, the son of the well-known publisher, has knocked up Zita, a Gypsy girl. Pittuiti sees red and decides to demand an eye for an eye. To this effect he sends his son Bruno, a guitarist, to the Védrineses', with the mission -not so impossible!- to seduce Gisèle, their daughter, in reprisal...

Title: 471. I ragazzi dei Parioli
description: A tale on the Italian upper class of the '60s and their ways to kill time.

Title: 473. Gunfighters of Abilene
description: A gunman receives a request for help from his brother, but arrives too late to save him from the lawless rancher who wanted him dead.

Title: 474. Tipi da spiaggia
description: Four penniless friends wich Belong to a small commedy theatre go to taormina a famous Italian beach resort willing to marry Barbara a famous multimillionaire cosmetic firm owner and forget their troubles. After a series of adventures the four youths go back to Rome with four new girlfriends.

Title: 475. The Moralist
description: Augustino works as the General Secretary of Social Morality Union and takes fight to all kinds of mundane vices - striptease, nudity in movies and commercials. He is incorrupt and unyielding. Unfortunately, the rigid professional ethics sabotages his private life. Meanwhile, his boss plans to marry off his unattractive 29-year old daughter...to Augustino.

Title: 476. The Cutey-Pie
description: Fed up with constantly getting fired, an adorable young woman sets her mind on keeping her new job as a columnist; however, a blunder threatens to send her back to square one. Can her love-smitten colleague save this delightful cutie-pie?

Title: 478. Totò, Eva e il pennello proibito
description: When swindler La Spada and his accomplice José are released from jail in Madrid, they decide to pull a really great swindle: nothing less than to discover and sell a third picture of Goya's "Maya in Camison" (Maya in a nightgown). They engage the renowned Scorcelletti who lives in Rome and can forge any artwork. Afterwards, with help from the beautiful Eva, they convince celebrated art critic Francisco Montiel of the existence of a third Maya and let him find the picture. When the swindlers are at the point of selling the fake to an American millionaire, Scorcelli returns from Rome to sell one of his six other maya pictures.

Title: 479. Poor Millionaires
description: Salvatore has an accident that makes him lose his memory and becomes director of the department store where his brother-in-law works.

Title: 480. The Last Blitzkrieg
description: The fanatical son of a Nazi general leads a squad of German commandos, disguised as American troops, behind the lines in order to sabotage the Allied forces. Stars Van Johnson, Kerwin Matthews, Dick York and Larry Storch.

Title: 481. Sogno di una notte di mezza sbornia
description: Pasquale Grifone, who lives in Naples with his family, receives in a dream the visit of Dante Alighieri. The poet suggests to the man, clouded by the fumes of alcohol, four numbers to play.

Title: 483. Far til fire på Bornholm
description: A family vacations on the small Danish island of Bornholm. Little Per meets a new friend, Torben, while Søs and Mie manage to destroy a movie production.

Title: 484. The Wind
description: A film about the Civil War between the Reds and the Whites, that followed the Bolshevik Revolution in Russia, and it's aftermath.

Title: 485. Inside the Mafia
description: The operators of a small upstate New York airfield become unwilling pawns in the struggle for control of a crime syndicate by two rival Mafia factions.

Title: 486. Astero
description: Astero, the beautiful step-daughter of a wealthy herder, falls in love with his handsome son, Thimios, whom his father wants to marry off to an affluent shepherdess. Now, she's on the brink of insanity. Can true love set her free?

Title: 487. Desert Mice
description: WW2 British entertainment troupe bring comedy and chaos to North Africa.

Title: 488. Douze heures d'horloge
description: Three criminals escape from a French prison and hide in a coastal village where they have to wait for 12 hours until the boat that is supposed to take them to freedom arrives.

Title: 489. Innocent Meeting
description: A teenager on probation is falsely accused of robbery. A young girl, knowing the truth, must persuade the boy to give himself up and overcome his conviction that he is condemned to being a lifelong criminal.

Title: 490. The Bells Have Gone to Rome
491. Yajû shisubeshi
description: A promising post-graduate literature student (Nakadai) is transformed into a psychotic killer following the suicide of his father and a sleazy affair by his mother with a younger man. One of the first "lonely hit-man" or "lonely killer.

Title: 492. Juke Box Rhythm
description: While in New York to select her coronation wardrobe, Princess Ann is photographed dancing with Riff Manton, son of impoverished producer George Manton. A dress designer, Balenko, gives Riff a large commission when Princess Ann buys her wardrobe from him and Riff uses the money to help his father produce a hit show, a Juke Box Jamboree.

Title: 493. It's Not Her Sin
description: After the man who nearly killed her is brought to trial, Eun-hie finds that she must take the stand to give evidence. However, the defense attempts to turn the tables on her by revealing her sordid past and trying to make it seem as if she deserved what happened to her.

Title: 494. Molokai, la isla maldita
description: Biography of the father Damian de Veuster, Belgium missionary of the Holy Heart order in an island of Hawaii.

Title: 496. Pier 5, Havana
description: A Yank comes to Havana in search of an old friend who disappeared during the Cuban Revolution, and discovers a group of Batista sympathizers plotting to overturn Castro.

Title: 497. Tank Commandos
description: A demolition squad searches for how the Germans are getting tanks across a river. An Italian boy leads them to a bridge under the surface of the water.

Title: 498. European Nights
description: A tour of the nightlife in Rome, Paris, London, Madrid, Vienna, Brussels and more. Artists seen performing include Carmen Sevilla, Domenico Modugno and The Platters.

Title: 499. Natürlich die Autofahrer
description: Eberhard Dobermann is a widower and a policeman who loves to control the roads and let people pay fines. Even with his neighbour and friend Jutta Schmalbach he has no pity. Thus he cannot understand why his daughter Karin just falls in love with a racing pilot called Walter. But it gets even worse when Eberhard wins a VW-Kaefer at the annual police party. So he has to learn to drive and thus even brings his teacher close to a heart attack.

Title: 500. Die schöne Lügnerin
description: In Vienna in 1815. A lovely corset-maker fell madly in love with a so-called first valet.

Title: 501. Dongshimcho
description: Widow Lee falls in love with a married man and her daughters are forced to confront them before their ruinous scandal destroys all their lives.

Title: 502. Samurai Vendetta
description: Honor-bound warriors find themselves torn between duty and desire as rival clans clash. Their paths cross in a deadly triangle of love, leading to an inevitable confrontation.

Title: 503. Dokuritsu gurentai
description: When Sergeant Okubo's brother is murdered at a Japanese outpost in Northern China during the Second World War, Okubo poses as a war correspondent and seeks out his brother's killer. The command is wiped out by Chinese forces and Okubo escapes and joins a tribe of bandits.

Title: 504. The Scavengers
description: This low-budget Asian-set adventure concerns The reformed smuggler Stuart Allison finds his missing wife Marion in Hong Kong. Marion has fallen in with a bad crowd and is involved with narcotics and stolen government bonds, requiring Stuart to extricate her from her woes.

Title: 505. Dos fantasmas y una muchacha
description: Two ghosts from a century-old duel haunt a theater and try to protect a girl threatened by bank robbers.

Title: 506. A Matter of Minutes
description: Dorothea Angermann the daughter of a clergyman is accused of the murder of her husband, a brutal man that she was obliged to marry because she was pregnant and he was the father of the baby.

Title: 508. A Simple Story
description: A woman arrives in Paris with her little girl to look for work. With limited funds and no luck, they end up penniless, homeless and dependent on the rare kindness of strangers.

Title: 509. Chhoti Bahen
description: Chhoti Bahen is the story about the delicate but powerful bond of love. Rajendra and Shekhar lose their parents, and the all they have is each other, and their younger sister Meena. Though in love, Rajendra swears that he will not marry till his younger brother and sister are settled. Shekhar falls in love with a rich girl Shobha. Meanwhile, Meena's marriage is fixed. Misfortune strikes when Meena meets with an accident and is blinded forever. Shekhar, pressed on by an impatient Shobha, marries her and they go away to live with her rich father. Rajendra loses his job. To support his poor blind sister, he is desperate for a job.

Title: 510. Dos corazones y un cielo
description: Husband and wife share the spotlight as two of Mexico's most famous ranchera singers, but when they decide to pursue solo careers, a Spanish theatrical empresario and an Italian female chocolatier will threaten their marriage.

Title: 511. The Children
description: Four boys meet at a kiosk during a rainy afternoon. One of them must study and the other three go to the cinema, although they're too young to see the film. Andrés works as a hotel bellman and dreams of being a bullfighter, "El Chispa" runs his father's kiosk, Carlos is a student, and "El Negro" is a shy boy. The group of friends just wants to have fun, but reality forces them to deal with the problems of the adult world.

Title: 512. Subway in the Sky
description: A military doctor is falsely accused of dealing illegal drugs. Can he prove his innocence?

Title: 513. La prima notte
description: A man of few scruples, the barman Alfredo, decides to steal the jewels of Isabella de Santos, a billionaire.

Title: 514. Mustang!
description: In the hills and forest surrounding a horse-breeding ranch an unbroken wild mustang (played by a male horse named Autumn Moon, who is not a human actress) who has been a constant challenge to the ranch owner (Milt Swift) and his hired hand Lou (Steve Keyes) who have attempted, and failed, to kill the horse several times as a bad influence on the tame horses of the ranch. One of the cowhands, Gabe (Jack Beutel)and the owner's sister, Nancy (Madalyn Trahey), believe that the mustang can be captured and tamed and be made a valuable asset to the ranch. Despite opposition by Lou, they set out to do so.

Title: 516. Yevgeni Onegin
description: His uncle's illness forces the nobleman Eugene Onegin to leave St. Petersburg for the countryside.

Title: 517. The Kingdom and the Beauty
description: A bored Ming Dynasty Emperor decides to take a vacation from his regal duties to a village that boast to have beautiful women. He then happens on a local beauty Li-feng, an innocent waitress who works in a local wine shop.

Title: 518. Lin Zexu
description: Set in the middle of 19th century, in city of Guangzhou. The United Kingdom stretches her tentacles to China, the country of great antiquity. UK exports a lot of opium to the Qing Dynasty and takes away immense amount of treasure. The "resistance" and "accommodationist" groups take intense struggles in the court. The Emperor supports Lin Zexu's prohibition policy of opium and sends him to Guangzhou as a Imperial Commissioner for investigating and prohibiting opium problems.

Title: 519. Vacanze d'inverno
description: Alberto Moretti arrives in Cortina D'Ampezzo ,with daughter Marcella,who has just won a TV contest ,the prize of which is a free stay in a luxury hotel.

Title: 520. T-Bird Gang
description: A high school boy, out to find his father's killer, joins up with a gang of juvenile delinquents.

Title: 522. Gunmen from Laredo
description: After his wife's murder, Gil Reardon seeks revenge on Ben Keefer. Framed for murder, he escapes prison. The Marshal permits Reardon to face Keefer and his brothers, criminals the Marshal couldn't convict. Reardon confronts them alone.

Title: 523. Chaleurs d'été
description: Two girls,a virtuous one and a hussy, fight for a young man in the vineyards of the south of France.

Title: 524. Murder at Site 3
description: Sexton Blake tracks down a gang who have stolen secrets from a rocket site.

Title: 525. De espaldas a la puerta
description: Tonight "The Golden Mouse Trap" is a crime scene sealed by the cops. Who stabbed young newcomer Patricia in the face? Her jealous workmate Lola? The pianist who might know her from before? The slick client with money to burn?

Title: 526. The Rambling Guitarist
description: Arriving in the town of Hakodate, a wandering musician, Shinji Taki, is soon recruited by the local gang as a hired hand. However, with the arrival of a sinister gunman, Taki's mysterious past catches up with him.

Title: 527. Speed Crazy
description: Racer Nick Barrow, brother of Wheel, competes in races across the country. When trapped in a race, a thrilling chase along a mountain's edge ensues.

Title: 528. Der Schatz vom Toplitzsee
description: Mysterious boxes sunk by the SS in the Toplitzsee (Austria) are recovered. The journalist Löhde, who senses a hot story, is to be eliminated by all means.

Title: 529. Mis padres se divorcian
description: A middle-aged couple has decided to file for divorce, but during the legal proceedings they engage in a ruthless battle for the love of their only daughter, a teenager.

Title: 530. The Fall
description: Albertina, a pretty but wet university student, is hired by a bedridden widow to take care of her and her four children. Helping out around the house she soon discovers the kids live a life of their own, independent of their mother, who neglects them. The atmosphere of the place is both fascinating and unhealthy and Albertina gradually finds herself stuck in it so that although a young lawyer falls for her, she won't follow him out of the house...

Title: 531. Las señoritas Vivanco
description: Dos hermanas solteronas creen que cometer un robo deja de ser considerado como pecado, después de ir a la confesión.

Title: 532. La nipote Sabella
description: Donna Sabella accompanies her nephew Raffaele and Lucia on their honeymoon in Rome when he meets two Americans who want to go to Pollena because there seems to be oil in the soil "The bubbles". Immediately Sabella abandons Lucia and Raffaele and goes back in search of oil. But the ownership of the land is regulated by a will that assigns it to the first female heir between the children of Raffaele and Lucia and those of Emilio and Carmelina, all yet to come. Donna Sabella will want to make her voice heard.

Title: 533. Eu Sou o Tal
description: Winner of a Theater talent contest, in which he was the only one to enroll, Belizário da Silva leaves his hometown, and tries to make it in Rio de Janeiro.

Title: 534. Verwirrung der Liebe
description: Slatan Dudow's best-known and last completed film, a big-budget production featuring Angelica Domroese (of later The Legend of Paul and Paula fame), Annekatrin Bürger and Willi Schrade. The film ran into trouble with official socialist morality due to its frank depiction of sex (including nude bathing scenes) and portrayal of consumerism, along with a very stylized version of comedy.

Title: 535. Isla para dos
description: A married, middle-aged painter falls for a young woman, awakening feelings of love he had never experienced before.

Title: 536. The Broken Record
description: A disowned composer whose songs and lyrics are plagiarized and re-arranged by corrupted studios before the copyright infringements took effect, composes one last song which could never be sung without his orchestral presence.

Title: 537. Laos Kai Kolonaki
description: Mad about the neighbourhood's blonde diva, an honest dairyman who struggles to keep his business afloat, decides to go to great lengths to get her attention, ignoring the only woman who has ever truly loved him. Will he open his eyes?

Title: 538. Sängkammartjuven
description: Rich socialite are falsely rumored to have an affair with an author. Meanwhile, the police is searching for a cat burglar.

Title: 539. Man Accused
description: Just after he has become engaged to a baronet's daughter, Bob Jenson is arrested for robbery and murder. He breaks jail, tracks down the real criminals and hands them over to the authorities.

Title: 540. Orzel
description: Based on a true story of the Polish submarine ORP Orzel (Eagle). In September 1939, Orzel docks in the neutral Estonian harbor of Tallin. Under pressure from Germany, the Estonians have interned the boat. With only a small amount of fuel on board and his charts having been confiscated, Commander Grabinski decides to escape to England through the Baltic Sea.

Title: 541. Rommel ruft Kairo
description: In 1942 the Germans devised an operation to introduce in Egypt spies to provoke a rebellion against the British.

Title: 542. Anata to watashi no aikotoba: Sayônara, konnichiwa
description: Kazuko and Umeko have been friends since college. They are modern businesswomen who have many obligations in life and are not ready for marriage. Their families think differently and strive to arrange their personal happiness.

Title: 543. Sangte Aika
description: Mahádev, the landowner of Rájurí village in Mahárásht.ra, India, is a tyrant obsessed with his own glory. Sakhárám, a poor farmer, dares to race his bullock-cart against Mahádev's, and Mahádev enlists Sávl.yá the dacoit to teach Sakhárám a lesson. Chimá, a dancer in the folk theatre, becomes aware of Mahádev's treacherous crimes against Sakhárám, his beautiful wife Hamsá, and even Sávl.yá. Destiny offers Chimá an unexpected opportunity to exact a terrible vengeance on Mahádev through his beloved son Kisná.

Title: 544. Onkel Bill fra New York
description: Hans' boss/uncle Bill from NYC visits him in Copenhagen. His wife left him and fearing getting fired, he "convinces" Johnny to dress up as his wife. Will the cover be blown?

Title: 545. I Am Free
description: Aminia is a young woman living with her aunt's family which includes her uncle and her cousin. The men in her life further reinforce the themes of male dominance in the film with their restriction on her life.

Title: 546. Diez fusiles esperan
description: During the first Carlist war in the 1830s in Spain a lieutenant falls into the enemy's hands and is arrested. When condemned, he claims he only wanted to see his newborn baby.

Title: 547. The Snow Flurry
description: A flashback story of a young man, from his disgraced birth, his harsh life and his forbidden love, until when broken-hearted, can break out in search of a place where to live means more than being alive.

Title: 548. Milagros de San Martín de Porres
549. Deadly Record
description: An airline pilot, falsely accused of wife-murder, sets out to find who really did it.

Title: 550. De sjove år
description: A bunch of festive students live at Egmont College, which serves as a hotel during the summer.

Title: 551. Labyrinth
description: Georgia Gale was a great poet, but then she stopped writing and started drinking heavily. Now, as a desperate last resort, she has traveled to Switzerland, where she hopes to find a cure.

Title: 552. Do Ustad
description: Orphaned brothers Jagannath and Rajan turn to crime for survival. Jagannath, a seasoned criminal, leads a double life, while Rajan aids the police. Their paths cross unknowingly. The climax unfolds with a police chase and a family reunion.

Title: 553. Rani Rupmati
description: During Akbar's rule over Hindustan, the Mughal's considered Pathans their enemies and vice versa. As a result there was a war-like relation between Mandva's Sultan Sujat Khan and Akbar. But Sujat's son, Wajid, was a peace-maker and a lover of the arts. He befriended a Hindu Kshtriya, Rajkumari Rupmati, of Mandhavghar, and despite protests from her parents, brothers, and to-be husband, Baldev Singh, she re-located to Mandva, where Wajid build her a tower so that she could view and seek blessings from holy river Narmada, who had gifted her to Mandhavghar. She became instrumental in diverting Narmada to bring water to her drought-stricken hometown. After Sujat passes away, Wajid becomes the Sultan and is called Bagh Bahadur. Akbar hears about this and sends Sangeet Samrat Tansen to check out Rupmati as well as find out if they wanted peace or war. Tansen was welcomed, and assured that Wajid wanted nothing but peace. But their peaceful lives will soon be turned upside when Tansen gets abducted by Subedar Hafiz Khan, is held against his will. An enraged Akbar asks his Chieftain Adam Khan to storm Malwa and free Tansen. In the meantime, Hafiz' daughter, who is in love with Wajid, gets into Rupmati's palace - with one intent - to kill her. Watch the outcome as the Pathans together with their Hindu allies, amidst mixed chants of 'Allah O Akbar' and 'Har Har Mahadev' prepare themselves for Akbar's armies, and how Rupmati defends herself against Hamida.

Title: 554. When Hatred Rules
description: A young couple returns from France to Greece full of plans for their life. But the young man's mother, assisted by other relatives, does everything she can to separate them.

Title: 555. Kiss Her Goodbye
description: Psychological tale about the disintegration of a young woman's sanity.

Title: 556. Policarpo 'ufficiale di scrittura'
description: The action is focused at the end of the 19th century. Policarpo De Tappetti is a calligrapher who works under the orders of Don César Pancarano de Rondò. For many years, Policarpo seeks a promotion and a raise that never came, and, it seems, will never come. One day, Jerónimo, the son of Don César, meets Celeste, the daughter of Policarpo, and falls in love with her. Policarpo sees in that relationship the solution to his aspirations at work, and does everything in his power to make this relationship fruitful. Don César, who presumes to be a count, sees with very bad eyes that his son meets a girl from such a different social position, and does just the opposite. But the efforts made by both parties will be of no use, since Celeste has fallen in love with Mario Marquetti, a "specialized mechanic" (typist) who is giving private lessons in the offices of the businessman Franquinet .

Title: 557. Sonatas
description: "Ugly, Catholic and sentimental", Javier de Montenegro is best known for the noble title he holds: that of Marqués de Bradomín. Rid of dying on the gallows thanks to Captain Casares, Bradomín helps him, in return, to flee to Mexico. Then, Bradomín retakes his old passion of youth towards Concha, married now with the Count of Bradesco. Six years later, Bradomín, now a gambler in Mexico, seduces the beautiful Niña Chole, lover of General Bermúdez, who heads the fight against the revolutionary troops in whose ranks is Captain Casares.

Title: 558. Moana
description: Explores Hawaii's landscapes and marine life, featuring coral reefs and fish. It highlights traditional Hawaiian dances, like the hula, and offers a glimpse into daily life, blending tradition with modernity.

Title: 560. The Black Chapel
description: 1933 in Germany. The rise of Nazism fears war and some officers, concerned the fate that hostilities would reserve to their country, organize an anti-Nazi group. They send a reporter, Golder, to communicate the plan of the German offensive allies.

Title: 561. 48 Hours to Live
description: A spy melodrama in which a New York newspaper reporter, sent to Gotland to interview a nuclear scientist, becomes involved with foreign agents who have kidnapped the scientist's daughter.

Title: 562. Signé: Arsène Lupin
description: Arsène Lupin and his accomplice La Ballu rob a villa. Being disturbed by the police, they have time to take a picture. This painting represents a fresco in three parts, La Ballu steals the second painting. The third painting is in the Florence Museum but when Lupin arrives, the painting is gone.

Title: 563. Dil Deke Dekho
description: An adopted rich heiress falls in love with a drummer who is unaware of his family's background.

Title: 564. La Valse du gorille
description: The Russian, British, American and German secret services are fighting over plans for a missile. When the Gorilla learns that its former leader is threatened, it abandons its garrison in Bayonne to enter this waltz of spies

Title: 565. Kagerô-gasa
description: A vagabond saves a young blind princess from a murderous plot. The two of them take to the road. A colorful adventurous melodrama, whose power is reminiscent of Chaplin's City Lights.

Title: 566. The Dead Man's Treasure
description: Theoni finds a strange way to gain some money, in order to pay her bills , by renting rooms in her rickety house.

Title: 567. Zhazhda
description: Odessa is under German siege and is in dire need of water. A special squad is going to fight off the water pumping station and water the city.

Title: 569. Il padrone delle ferriere
description: Philippe Derblay, master of Pont Avesnes ironworks, is an honest and generous young man loved by his workers. He has long been in love with Marchioness Claire de Beaulieu.

Title: 571. Raj Tilak
description: A young man goes on a quest to find his mother and to restore justice in a kingdom that has fallen into the hands of traitors.

Title: 572. Blessings of the Land
description: A young married couple, Maria and Jose (Rosa Rosal and Tony Santos) start life together creating a lanzones orchard in the countryside. They have four children - Miguel (Leroy Salvador), Arturo (Carlos Padilla Jr), Angelita (Marita Zobel), and Lito (Danilo Jurado). The eldest, Miguel, is a deaf-mute. Life is good to them and the children grow up and bring joy to the community. But trouble enters their lives when Jose makes an enemy of Bruno (Joseph de Cordova). Bruno, a widower, is much feared in the village, for it is rumored that he caused the death of his wife. And yet he wants to remarry and is courting Choleng (Mila Ocampo), Jose's niece. But Choleng avoids Bruno and one day, in trying to get away from him, she slips and falls off a cliff and dies. The village is outraged and Bruno hides in the mountains. There, he plots his revenge on the village, particularly on Jose's family.

Title: 573. Black Cat
description: Few people in real life would relish making the decision that Inspector Rajan is forced to take when he corners the identity of Black Cat a notorious character who lives the life of a professor by day and a crook by night. Inspector Rajan is deputed to bring in Black Cat dead or alive by his chief, the Commissioner of Police. Despite his long record of success in the police force, Rajan is driven to desperation at the sheer genius of Black Cat who avoids all the nets laid for him. Also engaged in the chase of Black Cat is a jovial private detective and his untiring secretary Bul Bul. The pair start on their own collect clues and despite the seeing bufoonery of Popat, played by Johny Walker and his ubiquitous companion, Shammi, they manage to bring to light quite a bit of information after many hair-raising adventures into the den of Black Cat. Meanwhile Inspector Rajan gets his long-needed break and suddenly the entire police force is electrified into activity, as the true identity of the notorious gangster is revealed.But all hearsay is of no avail.Rajan must have proof of Black Cat's guilt. This sets the stage for the most thrilling screen adventures of the day. Black Cat and his hoodlums work so methodically and are so well organized that to unravel the mystery of their gang the Inspector must venture right into the midst of their headquarters, and carry his life in his own hands, to put it literally.

Title: 574. La vida de Agustín Lara
description: A biopic of composer Agustín Lara, from his humble arrival in Mexico City looking for fame and fortune to his meteoric rise to stardom. Includes his early gig in a brothel, his love affairs, and the music that made him famous.

Title: 575. Gangster Boss
description: Two con men kidnap a wealthy man's young son while pretending to be Indians, but the troublesome boy proves more challenging than expected.

Title: 576. Krzyz Walecznych
description: Three episodes showing the repercussions of war. A soldier returns to his ruined village, a stray dog turns out to be the former guard at Auschwitz, a young widow is hailed as the wife of the hero but dreams of something else.

Title: 577. 91:an Karlsson muckar (tror han)
description: Squadron leader Morgonkröken writes two letters, but gets confused and happens to send one to the colonel where he calls him "an old fart".

Title: 579. Sister's Garden
description: The Nam family leads a life of upper-middle class luxury. But this wealth lies on unstable foundations, and when the father dies suddenly, Jung-hee, as the new head of the family, finds herself with steep debts and no source of income. At last, she must decide on something that riskier than before.

Title: 581. Bobbikins
description: Shirley Jones and Max Bygraves portray the parents of the title character, an infant who talks like an adult.

Title: 582. Un vaso de whisky
description: Víctor is a handsome boy, skeptical and lover of the pleasures of life. He has no job or benefit and lives on women without realizing that his behavior triggers dramas and disappointments, pain and hopelessness.

Title: 583. The Boy and the Bridge
description: After an unpleasant argument with his dad, a boy has interesting adventures all around London town as he runs away from home and is sought by police.

Title: 584. Tokyo After Dark
description: Military policeman attempts to escape Japanese authorities following his accidental killing of a Japanese teenager

Title: 585. Neend
description: A romance between a wealthy businessman and a poor coal collector turns sour.

Title: 587. Charles tante
description: Charles and Peter have passed their law degree and are looking forward to woo a few girls in the country. For that, they need to persuade their fellow student Ditlev to play Charles' aunt from Brazil, until Charles' real aunt turns up.

Title: 588. Los tramposos
description: Two clever scoundrels somehow manage to live quite well without working--by using thousands of tricks, fakes, and schemes. But they gradually change their attitudes, and their devious ways, when true love finally arrives and takes over their hearts.

Title: 589. Luna de verano
description: Two young French girls, Monique and Colette, arrive to Spain in their convertible car to attend summer courses at the International University of San Sebastian. The first contact with the country is in Pamplona. There, Monique considers heroes the boys who run in front of the bulls during the San Fermines.

Title: 590. Nakanune
description: The story is set in the 1800s. Elena and Inzarov, a Bulgarian revolutionary, fall in love. After getting married, they decide to join the liberation front, but on the eve of departure Inzarov dies. Elena takes his body to the Balkans.

Title: 591. Breakout
description: A government official arranges prison breaks as a sideline, but the police steps in and his gang is caught.

Title: 592. Barkha
description: Ajit is a poor farmer who has mortgaged his land with Zamindar Haridas. Ajit gets in the bad books of Haridas, and as a result he loses his house and property, on the very day of his sister's marriage. Ajit loses his temper and assaults Haridas, and as a result is arrested and imprisoned. His sister, Parvati, on her own now, gets molested, but is rescued in the nick of time by Haridas' son, Dr. Manohar, who eventually marries her, much to the anger of his dad. When Ajit is released from prison, he comes to Haridas' house with a sharp knife, bent on vengeance at any cost, not knowing that his sister is married in this family.

Title: 593. 15 bajo la lona
description: Fifteen university students have to join the military camp "El Robledo" for three months, undergoing a profound transformation to become university militia officers. They share a tent, joys and sorrows of military life.

Title: 594. Vrata ostaju otvorena
description: A juvenile delinquent escapes the hall and responses to ad of the parents who lost their son in WWII. After being accepted with much love and care, he reconsiders his initial plan to rob the family.

Title: 596. The Adventures of Sun Wukong
description: The mythical adventures of the legendary Chinese trickster Monkey, who must outwit a variety of wily demons who stand in the way of him and his fellow Buddhist travelers. Though portrayed as a literal, if rather anthropomorphized, monkey in the original legends, this film substitutes the spindly comic actor Norihei Miki, sans makeup.

Title: 597. Awantura o Basie
description: Stanislawa Olszanska is supposed to take care of several-year-old Basia, the daughter of her deceased friend. By accident, the girl goes to the writer Stanislaw Olszowski.

Title: 598. Kein Mann zum Heiraten
description: A wealthy dilettante tries to prove himself to his girlfriend so he can marry her.

Title: 600. Pensione Edelweiss
description: You'll live this world like a balloon which a child releases.

Title: 602. O Primo Basílio
description: During the absence of Jorge, a mining engineer, Luísa, his wife, allowed himself to be seduced by Basílio, a relative whom he had broken years before, who had gone to Brazil.

Title: 603. The Crowning Touch
description: Several stories linked by a hat.

Title: 604. Riot in Juvenile Prison
description: When the shootings of two juvenile inmates bring public protest, a psychologist is brought in to see if he can do anything to control the problems peacefully.

Title: 607. Rebound
description: Douglas Baines, a wartime army deserter, is lying low in a shabby flat with his girlfriend Daisy and the couple's small son, Jiffy. Returning home with a toy for Jiffy's second birthday, he learns that Daisy has had the boy adopted. After she refuses to tell him where the boy is, he strangles her and goes on the run.

Title: 608. Three Girls Named Anna
description: A retired tram driver tries to find his daughter named Ana whom he lost in WWII.

Title: 609. A Girl Against Napoleon
description: In 1808, Spain is occupied by Napoleonic troops and a beautiful gypsy's heart holds love for both a Spanish rebel and a French officer.

Title: 610. Rechukka Pagatichukka
description: Vijay Kumar after knowing about the injustice done to his father by Vikrama Simha, decides to teach him a lesson along with his father and to save the kingdom too.

Title: 611. Jeca Tatu
description: Jeca Tatu is a lazy, simple-minded guy who has his property threatened by the greed of a landowner.

Title: 612. Adam Wants to Be a Man
description: In a pre-WWII Lithuanian town, occupied with unemployed workers and crooks of various kinds, lives Adam, a naive young man with no job and a lot of dreams. His closest friend is the Captain, an old sea wolf with many tales to tell about Singapore, Hawaii and other equally exotic and sunny places. Inspired by his stories, Adam manages to get a job in an emigration bureau and starts saving for his ticket to leave abroad.

Title: 613. Grand Hotel
description: People staying at or working in a luxurious hotel undergo a variety of crises in their personal lives.

Title: 614. El negoción
description: In a town that relies heavily on horses, two men try to get rich by patenting and selling bags that hold the animals' body waste.

Title: 615. Maruja
description: In a small rural town, everybody lays eyes on Maruja, the most beautiful woman there. After the son of the mayor comes back from France, he also notices Maruja, setting forth events of love, jealousy, guilt, and anger.

Title: 616. My Little Seamstress
description: Aurora is a modest young girl, working as dressmaker for the women her popular district, near the OPorto cathedral. One day, through a hintz-dress design competition, she gets involved with a haut couture atelier.

Title: 617. Checkerboard
description: A dying desert town becomes a flashpoint for racial violence when a young white man asks an African American girl out to the annual dance.

Title: 618. Too Late to Love
description: In a small town where he is waiting for his train, reporter-photographer Walter Hermelin meets Catherine Ferrer, a female lawyer who has just obtained the acquittal of a man accused of having killed his alcoholic father. Catherine must now plead in a libel suit against a wine-selling company and she has the idea to ask Walter to help her get exhibits incriminating the wine merchants. The reporter agrees and takes frightening photographs showing how poor people, including youngsters, are incited to drink and destroy their health...

Title: 619. 5 loddrett
description: Knut leads a record company, and one time he's on the town he meets the night club singer Anita Daae. Now his wife has to win him back, and the advice she gets is to change.

Title: 620. A Whistle in My Heart
description: In the outskirts of a city in Hokkaido, an indigenous Ainu family faces discrimination from their Japanese neighbors, as well as various inter-family problems.

Title: 621. Counterplot
description: Man hides out in Puerto Rico from the police and his double-crossing attorney.

Title: 622. El regreso del monstruo
description: This is a secuel to "The Phantom Stagecoach" of the Zorro Escarlata (Scarlet Fox) movie serials, this time Sacrlet Fox battles a huge monster created by evil science and black magic,and in the pure style of Gene Autry's The Phantom Empire,mixes,horror,sci-fi, and singing cowboys (in this case singing charros) to create one of the most bizarre and intresting combos of the 50s in mexican movies

Title: 623. Kabale und Liebe
description: Ferdinand is an army major and son of President von Walter; Luise Miller is the daughter of a middle-class musician. When they fall in love, their fathers urge them to end their relationship.

Title: 624. El sordo
description: A sculptor who makes images of saints is beaten by a bully and becomes deaf, which makes raising an abandoned orphan difficult.

Title: 625. Åsa-Nisse jubilerar
description: The local newspaper celebrates 50 years and are now looking for a citizen who has lived as long in the neighborhood. Our hero Åsa-Nisse seems to fit the profile.

Title: 626. The Last Inch
description: A veteran pilot decides to make some extra-money by filming underwater shark feeding. He takes along his son. While filming, he is attacked, and he cannot fly the plane home. Their only chance of survival is for the boy to fly the plane.

Title: 627. Farewell to Spring
description: Longtime friends reunite only to find out that their bonds are not as strong as they thought they were.

Title: 628. Operation Bullshine
description: The fun starts when a group of A.T.S. girls are posted to a light ack-ack command post on a remote part of the English coast.

Title: 629. The Big Boss
description: Ryuta and Mineo Komatsu are brothers, both yakuza (gangsters). Mineo, although complicit in crime, even murder, wants out of the gangster life, hoping to become a successful singer instead. Ryuta loves his brother, but Mineo's possible defection presents problems for the gang, and Ryuta realizes he must kill his brother if he wants to survive.

Title: 630. Operation Dames
description: During the Korean War, a troupe of traveling USO entertainers find themselves behind enemy lines with a squad of American soldiers. Together they try to find their way back to their own lines while trying to avoid capture, but the North Koreans discover their presence and set out after them.

Title: 631. The Child and the Killer
description: On-the-run psychopathic escaped murderer Mather (Ryck Rydon) sweet-talks a very imaginative small boy Tommy (played by 11-year-old Richard Williams) into believing that if he quietly fetches him a gun and food, Mather will give him a favorable introduction to outlaw Jesse James.

Title: 632. La Paloma
description: Two prestigious variety theatres want to put together a musical around "La Paloma", one of the most famous and most-played songs in the world. A merciless struggle begins between the two theatre directors, Selten and Bauer.

Title: 633. Mamula Camp
description: Story of people in a camp, situated on a small island and ruled by Nazis.

Title: 634. Khovanschina
description: An opera about the Moscow uprising of 1682. Reacting against Westernization, boyar Ivan Khovansky raises a rebellion against regent Sofia Alekseyevna and the two young Tsars Peter I and Ivan V.

Title: 635. Le confident de ces dames
description: A vet used to treat animals; now he treats their masters.

Title: 636. India
description: A man who crossed the river fleeing from the police is found by a tribe led by Ansisé, a beautiful Indian who lives in the Ibitiruzu, Paraguay.

Title: 638. Unamenables
description: A young, active girl from a factory is assigned to look after her workmates - two idlers who only waste everyone's time. Unexpectedly, they grew attached to each other.

Title: 639. O Pão
description: Each day, Man must work around the clock to produce and acquire bread: throwing the seeds into earth, helping the breeding of the corn, the corn's recolt, transport to the mills - traditional or industrial ones -, manipulation of the flour into actual bread, transport to a variety of locations and consumers. And then, after the consumption, the cycle restarts.

Title: 641. Make Mine a Million
description: Sid Gibson is a soap powder salesman who decides what he really needs is TV advertising. The problem is, he's absolutely broke. He calls upon his friend Arthur Ashton, who arranges to sneak a plug for Sid's suds into a live TV spectacular. The public goes bananas for the product but to maintain sales Sid and Arthur must arrange for ever more outrageous plugs on TV shows. The Ascots races, the Edinburgh Military Tattoo - no show is safe.

Title: 642. Il magistrato
description: Emilia Bonelli is an overly ambitious and driven woman. This dominant personality trait has its effects on her henpecked husband Luigi, and her daughter Carla. Circumstances ultimately lead to the courtroom and an aloof judge in the persona of Andrea Morandi.

Title: 643. Action Stations
description: A forger (Carpenter) flees to Spain but his daughter is kidnapped by a ruthless gang.

Title: 645. Onna kyûketsuki
description: A woman who's been missing for twenty years suddenly turns up alive, and looking not a day older than when she vanished. When her daughter sees a painting of a woman identical to her mother, her reporter boyfriend helps her track down the owner.

Title: 646. Lucky Dragon No. 5
description: The story of a Japanese fishing boat whose crew were accidental victims of fallout from the Bikini hydrogen bomb tests.

Title: 647. Wolves of the Deep
description: Italian submariners trapped in their damaged boat on the ocean floor.

Title: 648. Ala Geyik
description: Halil is a young man who is interested in hunting deer. Halil's fiancee, Zeynep, complains about Halil's passion. A man named Karaca Ali is also in love with Zeynep.

Title: 649. Ardhangini
description: At the very moment of her birth, ill-fated Chhaya's mother passes away, her dad loses his job, and their house burns down. She is shunned since then by children her age as well as their parents. Her dad brings her up with a lot of love, and even arranges her marriage with a young man, whose mother, uncle and nephew approve of Chhaya. But when the uncle finds out about Chhaya's past, they reject her. This news kills her dad, and Chhaya re-locates to live with her friend, Leela Lal, who lives a middle-class lifestyle with her husband, Murari, and her mother-in-law, who is very superstitious and never lets Leela out of her sight. Murari and Leela introduce her to Prakash, an airline pilot, and both eventually fall in love with each other. When Prakash takes her with him to meet his mom, Chhaya finds out that she is the same woman who rejected her and abruptly leaves without meeting anyone. Prakash manages to convince her to marry him despite of her background, and she does. Both go to live with Prakash's family, but Chhaya is treated as an outcast and every possible mishap is blamed on her presence. Will Chhaya's presence continue to cause problems in this household also - especially when Prakash's plane goes missing?

Title: 651. Bibô ni tsumi ari
description: In a rural neighborhood of Tokyo, the owner of a farm is abandoned by his two daughters who are attracted to the life of the big city.

Title: 652. Salem Aleikum
description: Peter Karmann ist Lehrer und nebenbei Musiker. Er geht mit einem Ballett auf Tournee nach Afrika.

Title: 653. The White Trap
description: Serving a jail sentence for a crime he didn't commit, Paul Langley makes several attempts to escape from prison, in order to clear his name. He also has other problems, his wife is about to go into labor with their first baby.

Title: 654. Uomini e nobiluomini
description: Nicola Peccoli has always nurtured his niece Giovanna, an orphan since the age of two and now of age, but he does not look favorably on her beloved Mario because he is just a simple employee and a lower class of society.

Title: 655. Dagli Appennini alle Ande
description: A well known Italian story about a teenage boy who stows away on a ship to Argentina, to find his mother in the remote mountain town where she has been working to send money back to her family in Italy.

Title: 656. Atomic Agent
description: Murderous foreign agents are after a scientist who has invented an atomic engine that could change the future of rocketry.

Title: 657. Attack of the Moors
description: Trouble erupts on the border between Spain and France when the future Heir to the throne is captured and held hostage. Many groups try to take control of the situation erupting in many battles. Larry Anderson

Title: 658. Rendezvous with a Stranger
description: The gang of murdering a factory personnel manager to facilitate the task of financial aid to the smuggling abroad through the factory, one of the staff stick to the charge, he will flee to Sudan, and up the brother of the owner of the plant from the outside, and meet favorite sister of the accused young man, marry her and his wife give birth to a child. The wife continue to contact her brother secretly in an attempt to find a way for his acquittal.

Title: 659. El Police El Serry
description: A careless police officer lets a gang leader escape before admitting him to a psychiatric hospital. Fearing punishment for his negligence, he checks into the hospital under the criminal's name.

Title: 660. Qabelni Fil Zalam
description: Khorshid Pasha loses his wallet in the street, which Hussein finds and returns, refusing the money offered as a reward. Impressed by him, the Pasha hires him in his office. Soon, his daughter, Lola begins to grow closer to Hussein.

Title: 661. Bezaubernde Arabella
description: When her rich fiance Helmut dumps her because she is poor Arabella travels to England seeking the help of her aunt as well as Lord Fleetwood and charming Robert to find her a wealthy husband who'll get her family out of financial straits.

Title: 662. Haha no omokage
description: The young boy Michio struggles with the loss of his mother while his widowed father, Sadao remarries the kind-hearted Sonoko, who has a daughter of her own. As Michio clings to memories of his mother, the family navigates the challenges of grief, love, and new beginnings.

Title: 663. Le secret du Chevalier d'Éon
description: Burgundy 1728. Old count Antoine d'Eon is overjoyed. His daughter-in-law has finally given birth to a boy and he will at long last be able to transmit his inheritance to his son Pascal. At least this is what he thinks, for Pascal has concealed from his father the fact that his son was ... a daughter, his eighth daughter! Well, enough is enough and Geneviève has no other choice but become a boy first, then a soldier and even the special envoy of Louis XV, King of France, to Catherine II, the Czarina of Russia.

Title: 665. La nuit des traqués
description: A young and hapless Antwerp thief (Sami Frey), working for a gang led by leather-clad Philippe Clay, quarrels with his boss and accidentally kills him in a fight. Enlisting his sister and her boyfriend's help, he tries to get rid of the body in the local harbor, attracting the attention of a night watchman who seeks to profit from the situation via blackmail.

Title: 666. Le cameriere
description: Gabriella, a maid, wears a jewel at a dancing party which belongs to her mistress, and when it is stolen she is accused of the theft and sent to jail. Some other maids organize a search party for the real thief who seems to be a moustached youth who continually sings a popular song.

Title: 667. Mikosch im Geheimdienst
description: Like the young Susi Lindinger, Ferdinand's friend, Ferdinand Mikosch and Otto Schummrich belong to the small theater group of Max Sperling.

Title: 668. El otro camino
description: The story of a widow who owns a coffee hacienda, focusing on the dynamics between her son and the man who romances her.

Title: 669. El puma
description: A young man achieves his law degree and decides to return to his parents' ranch, with the aim of helping the community overcome a series of problems.

Title: 670. Pitong gatang
description: TERRIFIC story - MIGHTY cast - SENSATIONAL performances - SUPERB direction.

Title: 671. Insaan Jaag Utha
description: A village girl falls in love with the newcomer Ranjeet without knowing that he is there to get the smuggled gold that he buried in her front yard many years ago.

Title: 672. Di xia hang xian
description: About the struggle of the Chinese partisans with the remnants of the Kuomintang, about how the population ardently and actively supported the partisans, and the old helmsman Chen A-wan, sacrificing his life, sank an enemy ship.

Title: 673. A sangre fría
description: Carlos, a young man from Barcelona's outskirts, is ambitious and wants to change his life, even through crime. He proposes to Enrique, a friend with underworld contacts, the perfect plan to rob the offices where he worked.

Title: 674. Le sorprese dell'amore
description: Women dissatisfied with their boyfriends decide to see if a swap will be better.

Title: 675. Wrong Number
description: Because she dials the wrong number, an old lady hears information which enables the police to solve a robbery and murder.

Title: 676. La Pica sul Pacifico
description: Adelaide takes possession of an island in the Pacific inherited from her deceased husband. She is opposed by the chieftain and a convict. To get the island's citizenship she tries to marry the convict, but he prefers to turn himself in.

Title: 677. Pervyy paren
description: Watch the Soviet youth living in the country as they labour, exercize, sing, dance, have fun and fall in love during which they may well be the best years of their lives.

Title: 678. Kal Hamara Hai
description: Trapped by a smuggling business person, a convicted young man seeks to get back on the right path and helps twin sisters, who have vastly different personalities, rebuild their lives that were devastated by the same smuggler.

Title: 679. Mumu
description: In 19th century Russia, Gerasim, a physically large, deaf-mute peasant, is brought from the rural village where he grew up to Moscow to work as a porter for Tatyana a wealthy high-society girl. Gerasim dislikes the city life until he finds solace in the form of a young puppy whom he saves and raises as his own.

Title: 680. Strictly Confidential
description: Two con-men are released from prison, but get straight back up to their old tricks.

Title: 683. Der Löwe von Babylon
description: Kara and Halef investigate an official who actually is a notorious arms dealer. This crook imprisons his own adopted son and the son's lover as well as eccentric Sir David Lindsay and a German professor, prompting Kara to free them.

Title: 684. La verte moisson
description: In 1943, a group of high school students decide to take action against the Nazi occupying forces. Showing courage and imagination, they manage to blow up the Kommandantur and to release hostages. But after the killing of a German soldier the Nazi police apparatus strikes back. The young resisters are arrested and two of them are condemned to death.

Title: 685. I Want to Be a Shellfish
